note: cut the cowl front and its facing on the bias (fold the fabric at 45 degrees) so the cowl drapes
note: satin has a nap: every piece is cut the same way up (the layout only mirrors pairs, it never turns a piece)
hook and eye at the neck, Black
fusible interfacing for cowl facing, front armhole facing, back armhole facing, back neck facing
seam allowance 15 mm and hems 15 mm included in every piece
